description: A deep muted blue-teal floor-length court dress with a low square neckline, opaque fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Broad gold woven-looking borders decorate the center bodice, skirt panels, cuffs and hem, with small horse and scrolling motifs. A cream patterned wrap hangs around the lower arms and down both sides, bordered in blue and gold. A broad decorative belt with round gold-colored fittings has a long hanging ornament with medallions and a tassel. Small round brooch-like fastenings sit at the upper bodice corners. Dark shoes partly appear beneath the skirt. Exact fabric fibres are uncertain.
